criteria.title: All reserved backup Phase 1 request kinds are subscribed and dispatched
criteria.given: the control-plane reactor builds request subscriptions or handles inbound events
criteria.when: backup request kinds 38400 through 38409 are considered
criteria.then: backupRequestKinds and the reactor switch include run, verification, restore, restore approval, retention, repository register, policy apply, recipe apply, definition apply, and repository probe requests

criteria.title: Backup registry apply requests are validated and persisted
criteria.given: an authorized operator submits repository, policy, recipe, or definition apply events with d tags
criteria.then: the handler validates required fields and references, applies the registry mutation, and publishes a signed success result

criteria.title: Probe and verification requests are event-driven triggers
criteria.given: an authorized operator submits repository probe or backup verification request events with d tags
criteria.when: the handler resolves and validates the target
criteria.then: it publishes a signed queued or duplicate result and invokes the configured executor without polling or sleep-based completion

criteria.title: Invalid requests fail closed
criteria.given: a request is unauthorized, lacks a d tag, contains invalid JSON, or references missing backup objects
criteria.then: it publishes a signed failure/rejection result and does not mutate state or invoke executors
